title: EM rates: Take profit on long KTB position, funded via FX implied yields

classification.rationale: The note closes a long KTB position funded via FX implied yields, a bond-versus-FX-implied-funding carry trade, with the exit driven by a rising cross-currency basis from exporter USD liquidity.
classification.runner_up_reason: The exit trigger is the cross-currency basis and FX implied yield move, but the trade itself is a rates carry position.
